positive_pixel_gates.must_show: A customer faces the cafe pickup point while waiting; the woman remains on the customer side.
confounders: a generic cafe portrait without an identifiable pickup point
a seated diner drinking at a table

positive_pixel_gates.must_show: The prepared cup is on the service-side section of the pickup counter as the barista places it.
confounders: cup on a dining table or on the customer-side ledge

positive_pixel_gates.must_show: Both counter sides and an open handoff gap between cup and customer are visible in one frame.
confounders: server and customer hands overlapping around the same cup

positive_pixel_gates.must_show: The prepared cup stays physically separate from both of the woman’s hands.
confounders: woman holding or drinking from cup
ambiguous merged fingers that seem to grip the cup

secondary_observations: portrait-guided visible facial appearance and long dark hair, without identity inference
decision_rule: partial_is_fail: every selected visual-concept gate must pass at both thumbnail and native scale in the same saved image; occluded or ambiguous critical relations fail. If no accessible saved pixels exist, mark INDETERMINATE.
